label: scam
title: Bank 'fraud dept' -- move money to safe account

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is your bank's fraud team. Someone is draining your account right now.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Oh no, what should I do?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: To protect it, transfer your balance to this secure holding account immediately.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Don't tell the branch staff, they may be involved. Act in the next few minutes.
